p1.note: Final Arabic line (﴿وقلنا﴾: معطوف على ما تقدم، وجملة كان لا محل لها ... صلة الموصول) belongs to 2:36 and is misplaced in the source; both readings carry a translator's note about it.
Turkish glossed مضمومات إليك as "kendine alıştırılmış/toplanmış" (alıştırılmış = accustomed, not in Arabic); changed to "sana katılmış, yanına toplanmış"

p2.note: For «والمعطوف هو الجواب المحذوف» both readings silently changed "the conjoined element (maʿṭūf)" to "conjoined to (maʿṭūf ʿalayh)"; now rendered literally with a marked translator's note.
